create_BilateralStats: create a BilateralStats instance tracking bilateral action values between an agent power and other powers
accum_bilateral_probs: accumulate bilateral action probabilities from a joint sampled action at each CFR iteration
accum_bilateral_values: accumulate bilateral values from rollout results for a power's actions at each CFR iteration
log_bilateral_stats: log bilateral values and joint action probabilities between the agent power and all other powers
hcat: concatenate multiple multi-line strings horizontally with a configurable separator for tabular display
